## Checklist (docs/engineering-standards.md §7)

- [ ] Design doc / ADR updated if behavior or architecture changed

- [ ] UI: keyboard, screen reader and contrast checked; strings in the message catalog
- [ ] User-visible changes are behind a feature flag
